title: The bars given weight

members.role: the story bars page the form is applied to: its bars grow in stagger with their values landing
each bar a prism, one light, a hard-edge shadow, every label where the flat bar puts it

does: A story bars page given weight: every bar extruded into a prism under one light with a hard-edge shadow, labels where the flat bar puts them. The form is refused together with plane= on one page, which is why this is its own recipe.
source: P58 T5 golden form-extruded-bar - no approved cut has carried it
